title: 80 CC0 creature SFX — roar_02.ogg
creator: rubberduck
license_evidence: The creator's OpenGameArt submission lists License(s): CC0 and links to Creative Commons Zero 1.0.

recording_evidence.speaker: rubberduck (submission author)
recording_evidence.quote: A little Fun-Fact: I don't even have a dog... I made most of these (including the dog sound) with my mouth... - I also used different filters to make them sound different...
recording_evidence.scope: Creator describes the pack as mouth-performed and filtered; the statement says most, not every individual file. Selected member is explicitly named roar_02.ogg in the creator's pack. No AI generation or procedural vocal synthesis is used in this project.

decoded_pcm.decoder: ffmpeg n9.0.2; retained PCM is the canonical deterministic generator input, so regeneration needs no decoder dependency.

adaptation.processing: Trim 0.070–0.850s; one-pole lowpass at 6000 Hz minus its 80 Hz lowpass; weighted DC removal; sin-squared entrance 1 ms and exit 15 ms; normalize peak to 0.32; PCM16 triangular dither with seed 918307. No pitch or time stretch, reverb, artificial vocal or layered noise.
adaptation.credit: Intro roar adapted from roar_02.ogg by rubberduck, 80 CC0 creature SFX (OpenGameArt), CC0 1.0. Menu clack is an original Gorcs mathematical sound design.
adaptation.listening_review: No human listening review claimed; timing and levels selected from source PCM envelope measurements.
